excerpts: restricted. Two estimators for the (common) homophily parameter, `beta_0`, are developed and their properties studied under an asymptotic sequence involving a single network growing large. The first, tetrad logit (TL), estimator conditions on a sufficient statistic for the degree heterogeneity. The second, joint maximum likelihood (JML), estimator treats the degree heterogeneity ` {A_(i0)}_(i=1)^N` as additional (incidental) parameters to be estimated.
